board: Adafruit INA260 High or Low Side Voltage, Current, Power Sensor (#4226)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico: the simulator encodes current (signed, 1.25 mA LSB) and bus voltage (1.25 mV LSB) as 16-bit MSB-first registers per the TI datasheet, and the datasheet-based driver decodes them. The chip-computed power register (0x03 = |I| x V) is not modelled in the simulator (reads 0) and is documented as such.
